metaShifts.description: Following 7.35c's intelligence item cost efficiency revolution, this patch systematically dismantles spell-based itemization. Orchid loses -2 intelligence, -0.25 mana regen, +25 mana cost; Bloodthorn loses -5 intelligence, +25 mana cost; Oblivion Staff loses -0.25 mana regen; Parasma loses 25% intelligence scaling. This reverses the previous patch's attempt to make intelligence items accessible, forcing spell cores back into expensive, inefficient builds.

Lightning proc items (Javelin, Maelstrom, Gleipnir, Mjollnir) all reduced from 30% to 25% proc chance, while Divine Rapier receives a complete rework with toggleable modes (+250 damage OR +25% spell amp). This creates more strategic itemization decisions for physical cores while reducing the reliability of lightning-based farming and teamfight damage.

Core utility items face systematic cooldown increases: BKB (90s to 95s), Manta Style (30s to 34s), Magic Stick/Wand (13s to 17s/15s). This reduces the frequency of key defensive and offensive windows, slowing down the pace of engagements and making positioning mistakes more punishing.

Shadow Blade and Silver Edge duration increased from 14s to 17s, providing longer initiation and escape windows. Combined with utility cooldown increases, this creates a meta where invisibility-based positioning becomes more valuable as other defensive options become less reliable.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Thirst self-healing now classified as lifesteal and amplified by Lifesteal Amplification. This creates massive synergy with Satanic, Vladmir's Offering, and other lifesteal amplification sources, making Bloodseeker nearly unkillable in extended fights.

17s invisibility duration (up from 14s) combined with longer BKB/Manta cooldowns creates extended windows for invisible initiation. Heroes like Slark, Storm Spirit, and Queen of Pain can now commit to longer rotations and have more time to find optimal positioning.

New toggleable mode (250 damage OR 25% spell amp) creates synergy with heroes who can utilize both aspects. Invoker, Outworld Destroyer, and Tinker can now adapt their Rapier usage to match their current needs in fights.

Health and mana bonuses increased from +220 to +250 each (+60 total stats). This amplifies the value for strength cores who benefit from both survivability and mana pool, particularly those building into late-game scenarios.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: Javelin, Maelstrom, Gleipnir, and Mjollnir all reduced from 30% to 25% proc chance. This significantly reduces farming efficiency and teamfight damage for cores who rely on these items for waveclear and AoE damage output.

Orchid loses -2 intelligence, -0.25 mana regen, +25 mana cost; Bloodthorn loses -5 intelligence, +25 mana cost. This destroys the synergy for intelligence cores who relied on these items for both damage and mana sustainability.

Cooldown increased from 30s to 34s reduces the frequency of illusion generation and dispel availability. This particularly hurts heroes like Anti-Mage, Phantom Lancer, and Terrorblade who rely on frequent Manta usage for both offense and defense.

Cooldown increases (13s to 17s for Stick, 13s to 15s for Wand) reduce the frequency of burst healing in lane. This weakens the synergy for heroes who rely on these items for frequent small heals during extended laning phases.

Carry.explanation: Thirst self-healing now classified as lifesteal and amplified by Lifesteal Amplification creates unprecedented sustain potential. Combined with +2 base agility, Bloodseeker becomes a nearly unkillable carry in extended fights with proper itemization.

Geminate Attack damage increased from 20/35/50/65 to 25/40/55/70 provides significant early-mid game power spike. With lightning proc items nerfed, Weaver's consistent damage output becomes more valuable relative to proc-dependent carries.

Reality Rift cast range increased by 50 at all levels and Chaos Strike creep damage multiplier increased to 2x improves both initiation range and farming efficiency. These buffs address CK's core weaknesses without relying on nerfed item synergies.

Mid.explanation: Shadowraze mana cost reduced to flat 75 at all levels (from 75/80/85/90) significantly improves early-mid game mana efficiency. This allows for more aggressive laning and farming patterns without mana constraints.
Meld bonus damage increased from 80/130/180/230 to 80/140/200/260 provides substantial burst increase. With intelligence items nerfed, TA's physical burst becomes more valuable in the mid lane meta.

Dissimilate damage increased from 100/180/260/340 to 120/200/280/360 improves farming and teamfight contribution. The 17s Shadow Blade duration also synergizes with Void Spirit's mobility-based playstyle.

Offlane.explanation: Base damage increased by 6 significantly improves last-hitting and trading in lane. Despite strength gain reduction, the laning improvement outweighs the late-game survivability loss for the offlane role.
Base armor increased by 2 and Defense Matrix cast range increased to 700/750/800/850 improves both survivability and utility. These buffs make offlane Tinker more viable in the current meta.

Atrophy Aura bonus damage per creep increased from 2/4/6/8 to 3/5/7/9 improves farming and teamfight damage. The Pit of Malice rework also provides more consistent utility despite losing the Aghs movement slow.

SoftSupport.explanation: Cold Feet mana cost decreased from 125 to 110/115/120/125 improves early game mana efficiency. This allows for more frequent harassment and setup in the laning phase.

Thunder Strike slow duration standardized to 0.4s at all levels (up from scaling 0.1-0.4s) provides consistent early game control. This improves Disruptor's ability to set up kills in the early-mid game.
Bedlam roaming duration increased from 5s to 5.5s provides more teamfight presence and zoning potential. The longer duration allows for better positioning and more damage output in extended fights.

HardSupport.explanation: Power Cogs now deals 50% of mana burned as additional damage, significantly improving the spell's impact. This makes Clockwerk more threatening in early game engagements and provides better mana burn punishment.
Rolling Boulder damage doubled from 30 to 60 improves early game impact and roaming potential. This buff makes Earth Spirit's initiation more threatening in the early-mid game.
Scatterblast point-blank range bonuses increased by 50% and Firesnap Cookie projectile speed increased from 1100 to 1200 improves both damage output and utility reliability.

Carry.explanation: Manta Style cooldown increased from 30s to 34s significantly impacts Anti-Mage's core gameplay pattern. The reduced frequency of dispel and illusion generation hurts both farming efficiency and teamfight survivability.

Lightning proc items (Maelstrom, Mjollnir) reduced from 30% to 25% proc chance reduces farming speed and teamfight AoE damage. PA relies heavily on these items for waveclear and cannot efficiently build alternatives.

Reflection damage decreased from 55/70/85/100% to 40/60/80/100% and radius reduced from 500 to 400 significantly weakens teamfight contribution. Combined with Manta cooldown nerfs, TB's illusion-based strategy becomes less effective.

Mid.explanation: Orchid intelligence reduced by 2, mana regen reduced by 0.25, and mana cost increased by 25 severely impacts Storm's core item. The reduced mana efficiency makes Storm's mobility-based playstyle much more restrictive.
Orchid and Bloodthorn nerfs (intelligence, mana regen, mana cost) hurt QoP's core itemization path. The reduced mana efficiency and increased costs make her spell-based burst combos less sustainable.

Phase Shift Aghanim's Shard no longer increases enemy search range by 200, and Dream Coil Aghanim's Scepter attack speed reduced from 100% to 90%. These nerfs reduce both survivability and teamfight impact.

Offlane.explanation: Elder Dragon Form illusions no longer apply on-hit effects when reverted, Corrosive Breath duration reduced from 5s to 3s, and Level 15 talent health reduced from +400 to +300. These nerfs significantly reduce DK's teamfight presence and survivability.
Hoof Stomp damage decreased from 90/160/230/300 to 70/140/210/280 and Level 10 talent health regen reduced from +5 to +4. These nerfs reduce both initiation damage and sustain in the offlane role.
Timber Chain damage reduced from 60/110/160/210 to 50/95/140/185 and Reactive Armor max stacks reduced at early levels. These nerfs hurt Timbersaw's laning presence and early-mid game impact.

SoftSupport.explanation: Level 20 talent Pulse Nova damage decreased from +40 to +35 reduces late-game teamfight contribution. Combined with intelligence item nerfs, Leshrac's spell-based damage output becomes less impactful.
Penitence movement slow reduced from 12/20/28/36% to 12/18/24/30% and Divine Favor armor reduced from 12/16/20/24 to 9/12/15/18. These nerfs reduce both crowd control and team utility.

Flamebreak burn duration reduced from 5s to 2/3/4/5s despite damage increases, and Level 15 talent Lasso cooldown reduction decreased from 10s to 7s. The reduced burn duration hurts area denial and damage over time.

HardSupport.explanation: Crystal Clone mana cost tripled from 50 to 150 makes the ability much less spammable. This significantly reduces CM's utility and escape potential in the early-mid game.

While Frost Shield damage is adjusted rather than purely nerfed, the intelligence item ecosystem collapse hurts Lich's itemization paths. Reduced access to efficient mana regen and spell amplification items limits his impact.

Sticky Bomb cooldown increased from 13/11/9/7s to 16/13/10/7s reduces the frequency of harassment and area denial. This makes Techies less oppressive in the laning phase and reduces overall map control.
